draft_key_information_units.information: Q1 2026 financial performance deteriorated significantly: net turnover decreased 29.6% to EUR 11.1 million, gross profit fell 66.5% to EUR 1.2 million, and the company reported a net loss of EUR 1.4 million (compared to a profit of EUR 0.9 million in Q1 2025).
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Unaudited net turnover for Q1 2026: EUR 11.1 million (-29.6% YoY); gross profit: EUR 1.2 million (-66.5% YoY); unaudited net result: loss of EUR 1.4 million (Q1 2025: profit of EUR 0.9 million).

draft_key_information_units.information: Sales volume plummeted by 36.1% to 517,600 9-liter cases in Q1 2026 compared to Q1 2025, representing a major period-over-period decline and a key driver of the turnover drop.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Sales volume, in 9 liter boxes: 517,600 (Q1 2026) vs. 810,079 (Q1 2025), a 36.1% decrease.

draft_key_information_units.information: Performance decline was primarily driven by three external factors: loss of control over Stoli Group (USA), LLC; Russian confiscation of the Talvis distillery; and a global spirits market downturn, compounded by delayed excise tax payments that led to bank account freezes.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: In January 2026, a trustee was appointed for Stoli Group (USA), LLC; Russian authorities designated related entities as 'extremist' and confiscated the Talvis distillery; global spirits market downturn; delayed excise tax payments caused SRS to freeze bank accounts.

draft_key_information_units.information: The company initiated Legal Protection Proceedings (LPP) on 30 January 2026 (court-approved on 5 February 2026) to restructure liabilities and stabilize operations; the deadline for the LPP action plan was extended to 5 October 2026, with legal effects remaining in force until 5 August 2026.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Filed LPP application on 30 January 2026, approved on 5 February 2026; court set initial plan deadline of 5 June 2026, later extended to 5 October 2026; legal consequences remain until 5 August 2026.

draft_key_information_units.information: The LPP filing automatically triggered an event of default under the Principal Shareholder's (Amber Beverage Group Holding S.à r.l.) bond documentation, which in turn triggered events of default under its bank financing arrangements.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Filing of LPP application automatically triggered an event of default for Amber Beverage Group Holding S.à r.l. under its issued bond documentation, which automatically triggered events of default under its financing arrangements with banks.

draft_key_information_units.information: Subsequent to the report period, on 24 April 2026 the Principal Shareholder initiated judicial reorganization proceedings (réorganisation judiciaire) in Luxembourg, receiving a four-month moratorium (sursis) until 24 August 2026, during which enforcement actions against bondholders are suspended.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Pursuant to Luxembourg District Court judgment dated 24 April 2026, Principal Shareholder initiated judicial reorganization proceedings; court granted a moratorium until 24 August 2026, suspending enforcement actions and collateral enforcement.

draft_key_information_units.information: Operational efficiency indicators showed mixed results: the Right First Time (RFT) rate improved to 99.5% (Q1 2025: 98.4%), but the On Time In Full (OTIF) rate declined sharply to 70.3% (Q1 2025: 97.5%).

Management is conducting an additional assessment of doubtful receivables provisions established in prior periods and strengthening the finance function as part of governance enhancements to ensure financial stability.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Continuing initiatives to improve internal processes: additional assessment of provisions for doubtful receivables established in 2025 and prior periods; strengthening finance function with new professionals.

evaluation.selection_rationale: The units capture headline financial performance (D1-D2), major drivers of deterioration (D3), critical legal and financing developments (D4-D5), a material post-reporting event affecting the shareholder (D6), key operational metrics (D7), and strategic governance actions (D8). Omitted routine boilerplate (governance composition, remuneration, risk lists, accounting policies, auditor details, market descriptions, minor operational data). Units are independently omittable themes; each represents a distinct material theme supported by the source. Priority was given to financial performance, major changes, drivers, liquidity/financing developments, strategic actions, and post-period events, aligning with the evaluation criteria.
